missing: A head-to-head of the actual 65W interchangeable-plug chargers (UGREEN Nexode, D-Link DCP-651, Mazer, Baseus, Satechi, MANTO/QIW) on measured output with all ports loaded, weight including plugs, how securely the swap plugs seat in UK and EU sockets, UK BS 1363 fusing/certification, and current US/UK prices with working codes.
why: No major reviewer answers this exact question: WIRED (tested 20+ travel adapters) and Android Central both cover the broader travel-adapter category and mention a 65W interchangeable-plug charger only in passing, with 100W or non-GaN picks on top. The pages that do focus on 65W plug-swap chargers are an untested Singapore affiliate roundup (CNA), a single-product niche review, two UGREEN store pages and an AI listicle. A focused comparison with measured outputs and current prices/codes could get in, but it would sit next to WIRED's tested adapter guide, so contested rather than fully open.
